name: B10-0277/2025 – § 12 – Am 11
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Clean Industrial Deal
part_text: 12. Urges the Commission to engage in sectoral dialogues with industries, academia, social partners and relevant stakeholders from clean tech and energy-intensive industries and (cross-border) regional industrial clusters to strengthen their competitiveness and facilitate their transition pathways; stresses that industrial ecosystems are highly interconnected and efficient, where closure of one facility affects the whole cluster; calls for an EU-level mechanism to prevent the loss of industrial capacity, particularly in key strategic and net-zero sectors; insists that the Member States, in consultation with trade unions and regional governments, must be empowered to assess alternatives to the closure of facilities, including the possibility of their public takeover or renationalisation in the public interest; stresses that companies that have received public support must maintain operations and employment for a legally defined period, with any infringement leading to the repayment of the support received;
